writeProtocol.requiredRequestDigest: lowercase SHA-256 hex of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 JCS canonical action-intent JSON; headers and transport metadata are excluded
writeProtocol.idempotency: product persistence stores key, requestDigest, resourceVersion and outcome atomically with the action effect; replay is allowed only for the exact same digest
writeProtocol.concurrency: new writes require expectedVersion to equal the persisted currentVersion
writeProtocol.orderStateMachine: pending->open|cancelled|rejected|execution_unknown; open->partially_filled|filled|cancelled|expired|execution_unknown; partially_filled->filled|cancelled|expired|execution_unknown; execution_unknown reconciles to a terminal or active authoritative state
writeProtocol.strategyRiskGuard: before any product-owned strategy action, require Strategy/RiskLimit owner match, paper or testnet lifecycle, live non-reference provenance, a product-supplied 1ms..24h source freshness policy, source asOf not later than evaluation, non-expired limit, killSwitch=false, and requested notional/slippage within the exact decimal limits

transport.stream: product-owned WebSocket or SSE using Data Fabric event envelope v2
transport.errors: stable FIN_* code plus requestId and retryable flag

dependencies.walletAuth: consume accepted central product session, mandate, approval and revoke contracts only
dependencies.dataFabric: map product events to canonical envelope v2; exactly-once effect through idempotent transitions
dependencies.explorer: link transaction hash, order ID, address and block evidence
dependencies.website: consume versioned handoff; finance-suite does not edit global navigation or registry
